description: Expose the nine theme color roles (background, surface, text-primary, text-muted, primary, primary-hover, accent-1, accent-2, border) and the heading/body fonts as one self-serve edit surface in the single theme config, and deliver a short pointer doc naming the exact file and how to change each value. Tokens-only styling means the swap is a one-file change with no component edits. The Team Lead fills in the real palette and fonts later; contrast (AAA text-primary over background, AA primary over background) is re-checked when real values land.
title: Expose theme palette + fonts as a self-serve edit surface
acceptance_criteria: All nine color roles (background, surface, text-primary, text-muted, primary, primary-hover, accent-1, accent-2, border) and the heading/body fonts live in a single theme config file; no hardcoded colors or fonts in any component.
Changing a value in that one file propagates across all guest-facing pages and admin — verifiable now against the current/placeholder values.
A short pointer doc names the exact file and shows how to change each color role and the two fonts, including the contrast re-check to run (AAA text-primary/background, AA primary/background).
The site renders correctly on the current values; supplying real palette/font values later is a one-file change requiring no component edits.
